name: bell
description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The compact top hanger and body match the visible Regular 1.70 Outline. The Filled clapper is a solid rounded half-disc: its upper edge closes the opening, while its lower curve and round outside corners follow the Regular Outline exterior. The closed clapper interior is united with its 0.85-unit outer expansion, leaving no U-shaped recess. Body/clapper separation and visible vertical bounds y=1.9..22.1 are retained. This intentional solid interior follows the Filled body treatment; it is not a counter. Fixed fill-only geometry; other Outline weights may differ. Owner-approved source. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved Bell after the solid Filled clapper correction. Both styles reviewed at source proportions and Regular 1.70; the Filled clapper is a solid part with no U-shaped recess.
